summary: CLI verification of final-gate resume flow succeeded. Created a fixture run.json with all steps completed, buildGateResults.__final__.passed=false, and blocked with prompt 'Final build gate failed...'. Ran `MOLTBOT_NO_GIT_CHECKPOINTS=1 node scripts/run-node.mjs goal resume test-final-gate-resume --yes` with MOLTBOT_STATE_DIR pointing to the fixture. The resume path did NOT short-circuit to 'All steps already completed.' — instead it printed 'Resuming: 0 remaining step(s)' and entered executeGoalWithAgent(), completing with a full Done summary and post-execution review. The blocked state was cleared and run transitioned to done. Fixture cleaned up afterward.
